entities.summary: Złoty Stok is a town in Ząbkowice County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, in south-western Poland. It is the seat of the administrative district (gmina) called Gmina Złoty Stok. It is situated on the border with the Czech Republic, adjoining the Czech village of Bílá Voda.
